function.description: Quote a Uniswap v3 liquidity deposit: given one or both token amounts and a price range, compute the liquidity this would mint and the exact paired amounts. Works against an existing pool (its live price is read) or a not-yet-created one (give initial_price). Read-only — never deposits. protocol='v4' quotes a launchpad pool (full range), or any PoolKey named in full with a custom tick range.
function.name: defi_data_lp_quote

amount_a.description: Human units of token_a to deposit (give one or both).

chain.description: Chain to quote a Uniswap v3 deposit on — the same address is a DIFFERENT token on a different chain, so name it deliberately. Readable: ethereum, base, robinhood, robinhood-testnet, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, bnb, solana.

hooks.description: v4 only: the PoolKey's hook address; omit for a pool with no hook.

initial_price.description: token_b per token_a — REQUIRED when the pool does not exist yet.

protocol.description: v3, or v4: a Pons graduated pool (full range only; the other side is 'native'), or a PoolKey named in full with fee + tick_spacing (range 'full' or 'ticks:lo,hi'; initial_price quotes the seed of a pool that has no price yet).

tick_spacing.description: v4 only: the PoolKey's tick spacing. Giving it names the PoolKey in full.
